component.name: SVN Client
component.summary: GUI for Subversion working copy operations

description.p: SVN Client provides a graphical interface for developers working with Subversion (SVN) version-controlled projects on Linux.

ul.li: Browse working copy status with coloured status indicators
Unified and side-by-side diff viewer with syntax highlighting
Paginated commit log viewer with full-text search
Checkout, update, commit, revert, and branch/tag operations

screenshot.caption: Working copy status view with diff panel

description.p: Initial release with full working copy management, diff viewing, log browsing, and conflict resolution.
